Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && python3 - <<'PY'
import zipfile,os,subprocess,tempfile
z=zipfile.ZipFile('dec_fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip')
# try a few likely LR-related poc seeds
names=[n for n in z.namelist() if 'poc/' in n and len(z.read(n))<800]
for n in names[:12]:
    p='/tmp/testin'
    open(p,'wb').write(z.read(n))
    r=subprocess.run(['bash','/workspace/submit.sh',p,'/workspace/analysis.json'],cwd='/workspace',capture_output=True,text=True)
    print('==',n,'rc',r.returncode)
    print(r.stdout.splitlines()[-1] if r.stdout else '')
    if r.returncode!=0:
        print(r.stderr.splitlines()[-1] if r.stderr else '')
PY
